'''Jonathan Dunn''' (also published as '''Jon Dunn''') is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[February 2000 New York City tournament]] on 13 February 2000 with [[Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi / Their Fire Has Gone Out Of The Universe|Hunt Down/Mains And Toys]], according to Doug Faust's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d253">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-02-14-nyc-mega-tournament-13-feb-00d253/ nyc-mega-tournament-13-feb-00], DeckTech (Doug "Phrim" Faust, 14 February 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-02-14-nyc-mega-tournament-13-feb-00d253/ GitHub Pages].</ref> He played at the [[2001 Hexacon tournament (27 July)]] on 27 July 2001 with [[You Can Either Profit By This... / Or Be Destroyed|Profit]], according to Steve Marshall's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d2729">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-07-29-viper-drops-hexacon-phoenix-7-27-01d2729/ viper-drops-hexacon-phoenix-7-27-01], DeckTech (Steve "BlackViper" Marshall, 29 July 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-07-29-viper-drops-hexacon-phoenix-7-27-01d2729/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
